architectural_units.name: Frontend
architectural_units.description: The mobile application developed with Flutter that acts as the presentation layer, managing the graphical interface, navigation, and user interaction.

architectural_units.name: Backend
architectural_units.description: The server-side software responsible for processing user requests, business logic, and data persistence.

architectural_units.name: Domain Layer
architectural_units.description: Contains the purest business logic of the system, as well as domain models and repository interfaces, independent of Django, the database, or external services.

architectural_units.name: Application Layer
architectural_units.description: Includes the system's use cases, which orchestrate business logic and define the flow of operations, acting as an intermediary between the domain and infrastructure.

architectural_units.name: Infrastructure Layer
architectural_units.description: Responsible for interaction with the exterior, implementing Django HTTP views, repositories accessing the database via ORM, and adapters for external services.

architectural_units.name: Flutter
architectural_units.description: Framework used for the cross-platform development of the mobile application.

architectural_units.name: Django
architectural_units.description: Framework used as the main tool for building the REST API in the backend.

architectural_units.name: MySQL
architectural_units.description: Relational database management system used for data persistence.

architectural_units.name: AI Service
architectural_units.description: External service used for generating intelligent responses to reviews.

architectural_units.name: Gemini
architectural_units.description: AI service provider used for generating review responses.

architectural_units.name: ChatGPT
architectural_units.description: AI service provider used for generating review responses.

architectural_units.name: Firebase
architectural_units.description: External service used for complementary functionalities like notifications.

architectural_units.name: Cubit
architectural_units.description: A pattern variant of Bloc used for state management and business logic in the frontend.
The communication between the front-end and the back-end is performed through a REST API, using JSON format messages for both requests and responses.

The back-end integrates various external services, such as artificial intelligence services (Gemini or ChatGPT) and authentication services. [...] These services are integrated through specific adapters located in the infrastructure layer.
The back-end integrates various external services, such as [...] Firebase for complementary functionalities (notifications, associated services).
The persistence of data is performed through a MySQL relational database, managed through the Django ORM.

architectural_units.name: REST
architectural_units.description: The communication between the front-end and the back-end is performed through a REST API, using JSON format messages for both requests and responses.

architectural_units.name: HTTP
architectural_units.description: The communication is performed through a REST API based on HTTP.

architectural_units.name: JSON
architectural_units.description: The communication between the front-end and the back-end is performed through a REST API, using JSON format messages for both requests and responses.

patterns.name: Client-Server
patterns.description: The system interaction is performed through a mobile application that acts as a presentation layer (front-end) making requests to a back-end.

patterns.name: Hexagonal Architecture
patterns.description: The back-end follows the Hexagonal Architecture pattern (Ports and Adapters), which allows separating business logic from the framework and infrastructure technologies.

patterns.name: Repository Pattern
patterns.description: Isolates data access and simplifies the use of the ORM in use cases.

patterns.name: Factory Pattern
patterns.description: Used to dynamically instantiate artificial intelligence services according to system configuration.

patterns.name: Dependency Injection
patterns.description: The domain defines interfaces that are implemented by the infrastructure.
